shortfallBody: An account may not have enough for an EMI due in the next 2 days. Open Horizon to see which one.
emiBody_one: An EMI is due in the next 2 days. Keep the money in the account the day before.
emiBody_other: {count} EMIs are due in the next 2 days. Keep the money in the accounts the day before.
chargeBody_one: Your bank is likely to take a regular charge in the next few days. Open Horizon to see it.
chargeBody_other: Your banks are likely to take {count} regular charges in the next few days. Open Horizon to see them.
testBody: This is how Horizon will remind you before an EMI or a bank charge leaves your account.
emailWhy: You get this because you turned on email reminders in Horizon.
unsubBody: Press the button to stop Horizon's reminder emails. You can turn them on again any time under Privacy and your data.
unsubDone: Done. Horizon will not send you reminder emails any more.
panelBody: A message before an EMI or a bank charge leaves your account, so the money is there. At most one a day, only when something is due.
deviceOn: On. This browser gets a notification before money leaves an account.
deviceOff: Off. Turn on to get a notification on this phone or computer. Each device is turned on separately.
deviceUnsupported: This browser cannot show notifications. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
deviceHomeScreen: On an iPhone, add Horizon to your Home Screen first (Share, then Add to Home Screen), open it from there, and turn this on.
deviceBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then come back.
deviceOnDone: Reminders are on for this device.
emailNotReady: Email reminders are not set up yet.
privacyNote: Reminders never show amounts or bank names, because lock screens and inboxes are not private. Open Horizon to see the details.
testSent: Sent. It can take a minute to arrive.
testNone: Nothing could be delivered. Turn this device off and on again, or check your email address.
errOff: Reminders are not set up on this site yet.
errTooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes.
errDevice: This device could not be set up for reminders. Try again.
errNothingOn: Turn on reminders on this device or by email first.
errLink: This link is not valid. Turn email reminders off under Privacy and your data instead.
uploadBody: Your newest entries are over a week old. Upload this week's statement so Horizon stays current.
weeklyNote: Every Monday, when your newest entries are more than a week old.
monthlyNote: On the 1st, last month's money in, out and kept, with a link to the full report. Needs email reminders on.
emisNote: Two days before an EMI, and when an account may not have enough for it.
chargesNote: Three days before a regular bank charge is due to come back.
